subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful after-compaction plugin hooks gain a supported current-session reset capability in core?
rationale: Adding resetSession to PluginHookAgentContext creates a new external plugin lifecycle contract; automation can identify implementation defects but cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support this authority and availability guarantee.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Accept the current-session-only after-compaction capability after all lifecycle guards, bundled-harness routing, contract documentation, and real behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Keep reset authority internal
options.body: Remove the plugin API addition and implement any required recovery through an owner-specific context-engine or bundled-plugin seam.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle API design
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers define a broader session-lifecycle plugin contract covering reset availability, errors, and compatibility.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session-only after-compaction capability after all lifecycle guards, bundled-harness routing, contract documentation, and real behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the existing compaction plugin hook surface that this PR proposes to extend.
